context_requirements: Neuronal lineage or APP-expressing cells for meaningful beta-amyloid neurotoxicity modulation
Expression of APP and amyloidogenic processing machinery
None of the nine tested lines are neuronal; all are non-neuronal cancer lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in APP or amyloid-pathway landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Consistent transcriptional signatures of neurotoxicity protection or amyloid processing in non-neuronal lines
Shared gene-expression changes across multiple lines that are specific to this mechanism rather than generic stress
